args.body:
Duplicate cleanup is ready to run, but merges cannot be undone, so I need a decision before I change anything.

I found 85 likely pairs (duplicates_2026-10-21.csv):

1. 73 pairs match on name, address, and tax ID (example: C-1001 / C-1440 “Pellham Industrial”). Recommendation: merge these, keeping the lower ID and deleting the other, so orders and invoices move to the surviving record.

2. 12 pairs match on name and address but have different tax IDs, so they may be separate legal entities (example: C-2210 / C-2875 “Ridgeview Holdings”, tax IDs 41-0091822 / 41-0091950). Recommendation: do not merge these without a manual review.

Please confirm:
- Merge all 73 exact matches (keep lower ID)?
- Leave the 12 tax-ID mismatches untouched?

I will not merge anything until you reply.
